name: Conduits
pages: A {i}conduit{/} is a magical artifact that can be crafted from a {i}heart of the sea{/}, a rare item primarily found as loot in {b}buried treasure{/}. Many {b}shipwrecks{/} will have a {i}map{/} to find such treasure.{pb}When {b}awakened{/}, a {i}conduit{/} will grant nearby players the {!}night vision{/} and {!}waterbreathing{/} {l:magic/status_effects/}effects{/l} while in {!}water{/} or {!}rain{/}.

To awaken a {i}conduit{/}, you must surround it in {b}1{/}, {b}2{/}, or {b}3 rings{/} of either {i}prismarine{/}, {i}prismarine bricks{/}, {i}dark prismarine{/}, or {i}sea lanterns{/} (see next page for an example). The inside of the rings must be filled with {b}water{/} to awaken it.{pb}The more rings there are around the {i}conduit{/}, the greater its effects' {b}range{/} will be. A full-power conduit will also {b}harm{/} nearby mobs in {!}water{/} or {!}rain{/}.

pages.name: Awakening a Conduit
pages.text: Remember that the inside of the structure must be filled with {b}water{/}!

The {i}conduit cage{/} is an advanced version of the {i}conduit{/}, not requiring the {b}rings{/} around it. Instead, the {i}conduit cage{/} is awakened by pumping water into it.{pb}It can also be used for {b}channeling{/} recipes with an {i}encased fan{/}, or to give {i}potion{/} {l:magic/status_effects/}effects{/l} to mobs or players nearby.
